title: Review of c40's local fuel cut: replicates on fresh seed 4 (cut at t=8000): the isolated body shrinks from 196 to 62 px (32%) within ~300 t and lives on as a remnant while disk fuel falls 0.79 -> 0.64; its fed twin keeps 191 px and the 12 bodies outside are unchanged
summary: Ran c40's cut.py and world.py unchanged on unused seed 4, cutting at t=8000 (c40 used t=12000) and following 1000 t. cut.py picked the most isolated body (disk r=28 px). Fed twin: target 196 -> 191 px, disk fuel 0.79. Cut arm (kF=0 inside the disk only): target 196 -> 62 px e>0.5 (enzyme in disk 269 -> 204), disk fuel 0.79 -> 0.64, bodies outside the disk 12 -> 12 (cut_s4.png, cut_s4.txt). A small bright remnant persists to t=8975, fed by fuel diffusing in across the disk edge, as c40 reports (35-45% of area on seeds 0-1; 32% here). labkit pack of the world on seed 4 to t=4000 in rerun/seed4.

observations.E: cut_s4.png: only the body inside the cut disk shrinks (196 -> 62 px) while its fed twin and the outside bodies are unchanged

controls_run.E: fed twin branched from the same state at t=8000

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, cut earlier (t=8000) and followed 1000 t; the body does not die because fuel diffuses into the disk, so this shows each body's size is set by its own supply, not that a single body dies without it.
